findings.title: Delete and Pause disappear from the list-view More menu
findings.body: In the list view, GrafanaRuleListItem passes only promRule to RuleActionsButtons.V2 (GrafanaRuleListItem.tsx:47), and V2 passes rulerRule={rule} with rule undefined (RuleActionsButtons.V2.tsx:95). AlertRuleMenu renders the Delete item only when `canDelete && rulerRule` (line 165), and the Pause item only when `canPause && rulerRuleType.grafana.rule(rulerRule) && ...` (line 123). The Grafana permission path now sets canDelete and canPause from promRule, but the item is never rendered without rulerRule, so a user with delete permission has no way to delete a Grafana rule from the list view. The old list passed rulerRule through GrafanaRuleLoader, so both items were present before. showDivider (lines 118-119) still counts canPause, so a divider can render with no item after it. The V2 file says it is kept behind a feature flag (RuleActionsButtons.V2.tsx:39-40), which limits the blast radius but does not change the defect. The test at GrafanaGroupLoader.test.tsx:191-207 asserts the reduced menu as correct.

findings.title: Silence notifications is a dead button in the list view
findings.body: The Silence item is shown in the list view because canSilence is true through the promRule path (AlertRuleMenu.tsx:94-96, 126-132). Clicking it calls handleSilence, which sets showSilenceDrawer to true (RuleActionsButtons.V2.tsx:100). The drawer is rendered only when `rulerRuleType.grafana.alertingRule(rule) && showSilenceDrawer` (line 104). In the list view `rule` is undefined, so the drawer never mounts and the click produces no visible result. The base list passed rulerRule, so the drawer used to open. Either pass the rule identifier to the drawer from promRule, or hide the item when rulerRule is missing.

findings.title: Duplicate is offered for data-source rules through the skipToken path
findings.body: For a non-Grafana rule, AlertRuleMenu passes skipToken to useGrafanaPromRuleAbilities (line 73), and useAllGrafanaPromRuleAbilities(undefined) returns Duplicate as [AlwaysSupported, hasPermission(AlertingRuleCreate)] (useAbilities.ts:309 and 313 give duplicateSupported = true because isPluginProvidedRule(undefined) is false; line 318). The OR at lines 91-92 then makes canDuplicate true for any user with AlertingRuleCreate, whatever the ruler path says. That bypasses two checks the ruler path enforces: ruler availability (MaybeSupported, useAbilities.ts:253 in the ruler hook) and the plugin-provided exclusion (useAbilities.ts:257 and the comment at line 256). So Duplicate now appears for Prometheus-only data sources without a ruler, and for plugin-provided rules. getRulePluginOrigin(undefined) returns undefined (utils/rules.ts:239-242), which confirms the undefined rule is not treated as plugin-provided. The same skipToken path is used by V2 (RuleActionsButtons.V2.tsx:56-59), and the V1 rules table uses AlertRuleMenu too, so this is not limited to the feature-flagged list. Gate the grafana Duplicate ability on a defined promRule, for example by returning NotSupported when rule is undefined.

findings.title: Federated-group check dropped from useAllAlertRuleAbilities
findings.body: The deprecated useAllAlertRuleAbilities previously computed `isFederated = isFederatedRuleGroup(rule.group)` and made federated groups immutable (removed line 241 in the diff). It now delegates to useAllRulerRuleAbilities, which hard-codes `const isFederated = false` (line 245) and has no group argument to check. Edit, Delete, Pause and Duplicate become available for federated rule groups wherever useAlertRuleAbility or useAlertRuleAbilities is used. The rest of the UI still hides these actions for federated groups (RuleDetailsButtons.tsx:38, RulesGroup.tsx:61, RuleViewer.tsx:101), so the table and the details page now disagree. The TODO at lines 243-244 notes the gap but nothing in the change handles it. Confidence is medium because I did not confirm that federated data-source groups reach the V1 table through useAlertRuleAbility in every path.

findings.title: GrafanaRuleListItem is rendered in the filtered list without a key
findings.body: The grafana branch of the rules.map returns `<GrafanaRuleListItem>` with no key (lines 157-163). The datasource branch on line 165 still passes `key={key}`, and ruleWithOrigin.key is available here. Without a key React warns on every render and reconciles by position. RuleActionsButtons holds local state (drawer, delete modal, clone redirect), so that state can attach to the wrong rule when the list reorders. Add `key={key}` to match the datasource branch.

findings.title: Grafana rule links drop the returnTo parameter
findings.body: The previous GrafanaRuleLoader built the view href with `createRelativeUrl(..., { returnTo })`, where returnTo came from createReturnTo(). The new href at line 40 has no returnTo. The sibling DataSourceRuleListItem still sends it (DataSourceRuleListItem.tsx:36 and 42). On the Grafana view page, the back button is built from useReturnTo('/alerting/list') (RuleViewer.tsx:96 and Title at 300-304), so it now falls back to /alerting/list instead of the filtered list or group the user came from. Restore the returnTo parameter to match the data-source item.

findings.title: Menu test asserts the regressed four-item menu as correct
findings.body: The test says 'all 4 menu actions should be available' (line 191) and checks for four menuitems (line 207). It grants AlertingRuleDelete at the global level (line 50) and folder level (line 58), so Delete should be present. The `ui.menuItems.delete` helper (line 42) is defined and never used. The count of 4 matches the regression in AlertRuleMenu.tsx:165, so the test locks in the bug. Update the test to expect Delete and add an assertion that the Silence click opens the drawer.

findings.title: Negative Delete test passes even when the grafana path is unused
findings.body: The 'Should not render Delete button' test (lines 100-116) sets the grafana Delete ability to [true, false] and the ruler ability to [false, false] by default (lines 63-73). It would pass if the Delete item were removed for every rule. It also never covers the list-view path that gets the rule only through promRule (V2), which is the path with the regressions above. Add a case where rulerRule is absent and the item is expected to show, or check the item positively in the same test.

findings.title: Comment and variable name still describe the removed ruler preload
findings.body: The comment at lines 81-82 says 'preload ruler rules', and the variable at line 84 is named cacheAndRulerPreload. The ruler prefetch was removed in this change, so both are stale. Rename the variable and reword the comment to describe only the Prometheus cache population.

contracts.action: Edit button in the Grafana rule list (promRule-based permission)
contracts.equivalent_path: public/app/features/alerting/unified/components/rules/RuleActionsButtons.tsx (V1 uses useAlertRuleAbility on the ruler rule)
contracts.before_after: Before: the list fetched the ruler rule, and Update came from the ruler hook with isEditable from folder metadata. After: Update comes from useAllGrafanaPromRuleAbilities, which marks it supported (AlwaysSupported) and allowed from folder metadata.
contracts.visible_effect: Edit shows when the folder grants update permission and is hidden until the folder loads.
contracts.failure_mode: While the folder is loading, isEditable is false, so Edit stays hidden until it resolves. Nothing is lost.

contracts.action: Delete and Pause menu items in the list view
contracts.before_after: Before: the list passed rulerRule, so both items rendered. After: rulerRule is undefined in the list, so both are skipped while their abilities can still be true.
contracts.visible_effect: The More menu in the list has no Delete or Pause. A divider can still render because showDivider counts canPause (lines 118-119).
contracts.failure_mode: Silent omission. The action cannot be reached from the list view and no message is shown.

contracts.action: Silence notifications menu item in the list view
contracts.before_after: Before: the drawer mounted from the ruler rule. After: setShowSilenceDrawer(true) runs, but the drawer requires rule to be a Grafana alerting rule, and rule is undefined.
contracts.visible_effect: The item is visible and clicking it does nothing.
contracts.failure_mode: Silent dead click. The state flag is set and never rendered; no error or log is shown.

contracts.action: Duplicate menu item for data-source and plugin-provided rules via the skipToken path
contracts.equivalent_path: public/app/features/alerting/unified/hooks/useAbilities.ts:253-257 (ruler-path duplicate: isRulerAvailable gate and plugin-provided exclusion)
contracts.before_after: Before: Duplicate for a data-source rule depended on ruler availability and was disabled for plugin-provided rules. After: useAllGrafanaPromRuleAbilities(undefined) reports Duplicate as supported with create permission only, and the OR at lines 91-92 lets it through.
contracts.visible_effect: Duplicate appears for data-source rules without a ruler and for plugin-provided rules when the user has AlertingRuleCreate.
contracts.failure_mode: The clone flow starts for a rule that cannot be cloned. The failure is not shown until the clone is submitted.

contracts.action: Federated rule groups in useAlertRuleAbility / useAlertRuleAbilities (deprecated useAllAlertRuleAbilities)
contracts.equivalent_path: Base useAllAlertRuleAbilities: isFederated = isFederatedRuleGroup(rule.group) (removed in the diff); utils/rules.ts:373-375 defines the check
contracts.before_after: Before: federated groups were immutable (Update, Delete, Pause, Restore, Duplicate off). After: the check is hard-coded to false.
contracts.visible_effect: Edit, Delete, Pause and Duplicate become available for federated groups in components that use the alert-rule ability hooks.
contracts.failure_mode: Users can attempt edits or deletes the UI used to block. Whether the backend rejects them was not checked.
contracts.open_question: Which rendered components reach useAlertRuleAbility / useAlertRuleAbilities for federated data-source groups? Only the RulesTable V1 path was checked.

contracts.action: Grafana rule item rendered in the filtered list (FilterView)
contracts.before_after: Before: GrafanaRuleLoader was given key={key}. After: GrafanaRuleListItem is given no key.
contracts.visible_effect: A React key warning appears in the console on every render.
contracts.failure_mode: React reconciles by position, so per-row state can attach to the wrong rule when the list changes order.

contracts.action: Navigation link from a Grafana rule list item to its view page
contracts.before_after: Before: the href included returnTo from createReturnTo(). After: the href has no returnTo.
contracts.visible_effect: On the Grafana view page, the back link uses the fallback /alerting/list rather than the page the user came from.
contracts.failure_mode: Silent loss of navigation context. No error is shown.

contracts.action: Grafana group loader: Prometheus-only fetch (ruler query removed)
contracts.equivalent_path: Base GrafanaGroupLoader: fetched getGrafanaRulerGroup and merged with matchRules, showing Creating and Deleting rows
contracts.before_after: Before: ruler-only rules appeared as Creating and prom-only rules as Deleting. After: only Prometheus rules render. Polling covers only the Prometheus query (line 40).
contracts.visible_effect: Rules deleted in the ruler but still in Prometheus show until Prometheus updates. Ruler-only rules do not show.
contracts.failure_mode: A Prometheus error shows the group-load Alert (lines 53-63). There is no stale ref or flag that survives remount, because the only state is the RTK query.

contracts.action: Prefetch of the Grafana ruler group during group population
contracts.equivalent_path: Same file, the Prometheus upsertQueryData call immediately after it (line 85)
contracts.before_after: Before: each group also dispatched alertRuleApi.util.prefetch('getGrafanaRulerGroup'). After: that dispatch is removed.
contracts.visible_effect: No direct effect on the list. Any consumer that expected the ruler-group cache to be warm now sends its own request.
contracts.failure_mode: Extra request on first use. The comment still says ruler rules are preloaded.

contracts.action: Removed locale keys cannot-load-rule-details-for and cannot-find-rule-details-for
contracts.before_after: Before: the keys existed under rule-list. After: they are removed.
contracts.visible_effect: None. A repository search found no code using these keys, only the translated locale files.

summary: The change moves the Grafana rule list onto promRule-based abilities and drops the ruler query, but the list-view menu loses Delete and Pause, and Silence opens nothing. Duplicate now appears for data-source and plugin-provided rules because of the skipToken path. Separately, the federated-group check is gone from the deprecated hook, FilterView has no key, and Grafana list links drop returnTo. The GrafanaGroupLoader menu test asserts the reduced menu as correct. I did not build, run, or test anything; all findings come from reading the head code. RuleDetails.test.tsx was read only through line 60, and its diff is small.
